chunks: From him, from Usman ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Ajlan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
He said: Indeed, Allah (Mighty and Majestic) reproached a people for their publicising, so He said: 'And when there comes to them news of security or fear, they publicise it.'
ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic ruling on publicizing news of security or fear?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) links the ethical prohibition of indiscriminate publicizing (idha'ah) directly to the Quranic narrative of the Banu Qurayza or the Hypocrites, who rushed to broadcast both good news and rumors of danger without verification. This serves as a critical scholarly principle for distinguishing between verified knowledge and speculative gossip, emphasizing that hasty dissemination often stems from a lack of deep understanding or spiritual caution. The warning underscores the social and political consequences of unverified information in early Islamic community dynamics.
